affected_component: import_hook receipt proxy (_make) + semantic_artifact counterfactual proxy (_make_proxy)
invariant: Runtime observation must preserve the observable behaviour and metadata of every wrapped upstream callable (v1). v2 extends this to the attributes the wrapped object itself carries: every public attribute of the original callable that the proxy function lacks (lru_cache's cache_clear/cache_info/cache_parameters, singledispatch's register/dispatch, __wrapped__ via functools.wraps) is reachable on the proxy, so an upstream that performs housekeeping on its own decorated functions runs unchanged under observation and under the counterfactual control; calls are still receipted and return values unchanged. Same measurement-validity exception as v1: a verdict on a program the Harness altered is not a measurement of the submission.
